clips.title: The story
paras: Aggressive Encroachment is a task issued by Valreaa Valewind to protect the local settlement from desperate wildlife. Ursera from a nearby den have grown increasingly bold, wandering into the village and threatening its inhabitants.

The ursera population nesting southwest of the village has become an urgent safety hazard. Recently, a hungry adolescent beast strayed right up to the base of the village's central elder tree, nearly mauling a young child playing nearby. The settlement's rangers were forced to cut the creature down before tragedy struck.

Recognizing that hunger and starvation are driving these predators to attack civilized grounds, the rangers have ordered a cull of the scrawniest ursera in Thendal Grove. By eliminating the desperate and malnourished beasts prowling outside the dens, the Rangers of the Grove hope to halt further encroachment until they can uncover what is disturbing the local wildlife.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The ursera den to the southwest is rapidly becoming a problem. Just last week the rangers had to kill an adolescent ursera who wandered too close to the village and attempted to attack a boy playing near the base of the elder tree in the center of the village.

We were fortunate that the boy escaped with his life. Hunger and desperation makes these beasts too dangerous to be left unchecked. Go south and put the scrawniest among the ursera down. Bring me their claws as proof when it is done.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The ursera have grown far more aggressive of late. I wonder what has changed to cause this shift in behavior?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, adventurer. The Rangers of the Grove are in your debt.
